defs.def: the part of a plant that consists of one or more seeds and flesh, can be eaten as food and usually tastes sweet 水果

ex.s: Before _____64_____ (head) home, they fill their shopping bags with fresh fruit and vegetables from local farmers, at prices significantly _____65_____ (cheap) than those found in supermarkets.
ex.t: 在_____ 64 _____ （头部）回家之前，他们在购物袋中装满来自当地农民的新鲜水果和蔬菜，价格比超市中的价格便宜_____ 65 _____ （便宜）。

ex.s: It helps local farmers grow fruits.
ex.t: 它帮助当地农民种植水果。

ex.s: Fruit juices, milk-based drinks and most alcoholic drinks are free of the tax, as are small companies manufacturing fewer than 1m litres per year.
ex.t: 帮助下一代拥有健康活跃的童年非常重要，行业也在尽自己的一份力。

ex.s: Tom watched his mum make healthy fruit infusions but then struggle for a take-along option.
ex.t: 汤姆看着妈妈制作健康的水果饮品，但随后在为随身带的选择上犯难。

ex.s: My husband and I agreed they were the best fruit we had ever eaten.
ex.t: 我和丈夫一致认为这是我们吃过的最好的水果。

ex.s: And don't forget to put out some cookies and fruits.
ex.t: 还有，别忘了拿出一些饼干和水果。

ex.s: I decided to think up a method of dealing with forbidden fruit.
ex.t: 我决定想出一个方法 对付被禁止的水果。

ex.s: The owner of the forbidden fruit.
ex.t: 禁果的主人。

ex.s: They ____55____ learned that the painting they ____56____was called “The Girl with Two Chairs.” They ____57____ the other painting and learned that it was ____58____ Paul Gauguin’s “Still Life of Fruit on a Table with a Small Dog.” The ____59____ called the Italian Culture Ministry; the official confirmed that the paintings were ____60____ and worth as much as $50 million.
ex.t: 他们___55___得知，他们___56___的那幅画名叫《坐两把椅子的女孩》。他们___57___另一幅画，得知它___58___保罗·高更的《桌上水果与小狗静物画》。___59___致电意大利文化部；官员确认这些画是___60___，价值高达5000万美元。

ex.s: Many of us love July because it’s the month when nature’s berries and stone fruits are in abundance.
ex.t: 我们许多人喜欢七月，因为这是大自然浆果和核果丰收的季节。

ex.s: When combined with berries or slices of other fruits, frozen bananas make an excellent base for thick, cooling fruit shakes and low fat “ice cream”.
ex.t: 当与浆果或其他水果切片结合时,冰冻的香蕉为厚、冷却的水果摇摆和低脂“冰淇淋”提供了极佳的基础。

ex.s: If you have a juicer, you can simply feed in frozen bananas and some berries or sliced fruit.
ex.t: 如果你有一个果汁机,你可以简单地在冰冻的香蕉和一些浆果或切片的水果中觅食.

ex.s: When it came to England, “apple” was added to show it is a kind of fruit.
ex.t: 说到英语，加了“apple”以表明它是一种水果。

ex.s: The 4_____ makes it difficult for us to grow enough vegetables and fruit.
ex.t: 4_____ 使我们很难种植足够的蔬菜和水果。

ex.s: With pleasant flavours and scents, and coming in a variety of colours, fruit and herbal teas make a nice change to traditional teas.
ex.t: 水果茶和草药茶具有令人愉悦的味道和香味，并有多种颜色可供选择，与传统茶叶有很大的不同。

ex.s: Fruit teas now include mango, strawberry, apple and pear.
ex.t: 水果茶现在包括芒果、草莓、苹果和梨。

ex.s: Fruit and herbal teas Their popularity ____________ Unusual flavours ____________ Health benefits ____________ Learning to learn When writing a summary, don't just combine all the topic sentences.
ex.t: 水果茶和花草茶 它们的受欢迎程度 ____________ 不寻常的风味 ____________ 健康益处 ____________ 学会学习 写总结时，不要只是简单地把所有主题句拼凑在一起。

ex.s: This is why decorating with plants, fruits and flowers ___62___ (carry) special significance.
ex.t: 这就是为什么用植物、水果和鲜花装饰___62___（具有）特殊意义的原因。

ex.s: This makes a fun activity for a children’s party; they love feeding the fruit and frozen bananas into the top of the machine and watching the ice cream come out below.
ex.t: 这对儿童派对来说是个有趣的活动；他们喜欢把水果和冷冻香蕉从机器顶端投入，看着冰淇淋从下方出来。

defs.def: a part of a plant or tree that is formed after the flowers have died and in which seeds develop 果实

ex.s: They bear a lot of fruit soon.
ex.t: 它们很快就会结很多果实。

ex.s: That willpower bore fruit when Jennifer graduated from University of Wisconsin-Eau Claire and became the first in her large family to earn a bachelor’s degree.
ex.t: 当詹妮弗从威斯康星大学欧克莱尔分校毕业、成为这个大家庭里第一个获得学士学位的人时，那份意志力结出了果实。

ex.s: I was back teaching after an absence of 15 years, dealing with the various kinds of "forbidden fruit" that come out of book bags.
ex.t: 在离开教学15年之后，我重新开始教书，面对着孩子们从书包里掏出的各种各样的‘禁果’。

ex.s: The yellow and orange stone fruits such as peaches are high in the carotenoids we turn into vitamin A and which are antioxidants.
ex.t: 桃子等黄色和橙色核果富含类胡萝卜素，我们将其转化为维生素A，且它们是抗氧化剂。

defs.def: all the natural things that the earth produces （大地的）产物；农产品

ex.s: They enjoyed hearing about all the forbidden fruit I had collected.
ex.t: 后来有一个圣诞节，我收到了一份惊喜礼物——一个大而精美的木箱子，是我儿子Bruce把我那个想象的奶奶的箱子变成了现实。

defs.def: an offensive word for a homosexual man 男同性恋者
